items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra发布即遭遇“混乱”：Altman向被拒付费用户致歉
items.title_en: Sam Altman apologizes for ‘messy’ GPT-6 Astra rollout that’s locked out paying users
items.summary_zh: OpenAI于周四发布了新一代大模型GPT-6 Astra，并称其为“能力的代际飞跃”，同时宣告“AGI时代”开启。然而发布数小时后，CEO萨姆·奥特曼便公开致歉，承认这是一次“混乱的发布”，因为许多付费用户被挡在门外，无法访问新模型。公司原计划当天仅向部分企业客户提供Astra，具体是使用其Daybreak网络安全平台的用户。此次事件让外界对OpenAI的大规模服务交付能力产生质疑，也再次凸显前沿AI产品商用化过程中面临的用户期望管理挑战。
items.summary_en: Just hours after OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra , CEO Sam Altman was already apologizing for what he describes as a "messy rollout" after paying users expecting access to the new frontier model were left waiting. The company hailed the model as a "generational leap in capability" on Thursday and described it as the start of "the AGI era," a fuzzy and poorly defined term tech executives nevertheless insist on using to promote their products. It said Astra would roll out to some enterprise customers - specifically those with access to its Daybreak cybersecurity platform - that day. This would expan…
items.why_zh: 这次发布事故暴露了OpenAI在关键商业化阶段的产品交付与用户沟通问题，可能影响用户信任。
items.why_en: This rollout misstep highlights the growing pains of commercializing cutting-edge AI and managing user expectations.

items.title_zh: 资金复盘| 北水净卖出港股100亿港元！加仓MINIMAX超9亿港元，扫货智谱、建滔积层板等港美股资讯
items.title_en: Southbound Funds Net Sell HK$10B, Add Over HK$900M in MINIMAX
items.summary_zh: 资金复盘| 北水净卖出港股100亿港元！加仓MINIMAX超9亿港元，扫货智谱、建滔积层板等港美股资讯 hstong.com
items.summary_en: According to fund flow data, southbound capital net sold HK$10 billion in Hong Kong stocks, but added over HK$900 million in MINIMAX and bought Zhipu and Kingboard Laminates. The selective moves suggest a structural shift toward AI plays despite overall caution.
items.why_zh: 在港股整体资金流出的背景下仍大量加仓AI企业，凸显南向资金对人工智能赛道的强烈偏好。
items.why_en: Despite net selling in HK stocks, southbound funds heavily bought AI firms, showing strong conviction in the AI sector.

items.title_zh: 绿联推出HomeAgent智能家居中枢：本地存储与设备端AI，主打本地运行
items.title_en: This NAS company wants to run your local smart home
items.summary_zh: 以充电宝、充电器和NAS存储闻名的绿联，正大举进军智能家居领域。本周在IFA展会上，该公司推出HomeAgent智能家居平台，将摄像头存储、设备端AI和智能家居控制整合在一个系统中，并由语音助手Uliya管理。其核心卖点是强调所有功能本地运行，减少对云端的依赖，从而兼顾隐私与响应速度。HomeAgent H100 Pro中枢是这一方案的关键硬件，目标是将家庭数据留在本地。这一布局有别于当前多数依赖云服务的智能家居产品，展现了硬件厂商AI化的新思路。
items.summary_en: Ugreen’s HomeAgent H100 Pro hub combines local storage, on-device AI, and a new voice assistant, Uliya, to run your smart home. | Photo by Jennifer Pattison Tuohy / The Verge Ugreen, known for its phone power banks, chargers, and NAS storage solutions, is moving into the smart home - in a big way. This week at the IFA tech show, the company launched its HomeAgent smart home platform that combines security camera storage, on-device AI, and smart home control in one system, managed by a voice assistant called Uliya, with the promise that everything runs locally. At the core of Ugreen's HomeAgent…
items.why_zh: 绿联将本地存储与设备端AI结合，给智能家居的隐私保护和低延迟带来新方案。
items.why_en: Ugreen combines NAS storage with on-device AI to offer a privacy-first, low-latency approach to smart homes.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek概念股板块9月4日跌1.48%，浪潮信息领跌，主力资金净流出30.86亿元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Concept Stocks Drop 1.48%; Inspur Leads Losses, Main Funds Net Outflow RMB 3.086B
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek概念股板块9月4日跌1.48%，浪潮信息领跌，主力资金净流出30.86亿元 Sohu
items.summary_en: DeepSeek concept stocks slid 1.48% on Sept 4 led by Inspur, with main capital net outflow of RMB 3.086 billion. The retreat signals cooling sentiment and may increase volatility.
items.why_zh: 显示AI概念股短期炒作退潮，主力资金大额流出可能拖累板块表现。
items.why_en: It signals cooling sentiment in AI concept stocks, with significant fund outflows pressuring the sector.

items.title_zh: 充Token如同充话费！天猫上线AI充值中心，阿里云、智谱、Kimi都来了
items.title_en: Tmall Launches AI Token Recharge Center with Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi
items.summary_zh: 充Token如同充话费！天猫上线AI充值中心，阿里云、智谱、Kimi都来了 新浪网
items.summary_en: Tmall launched an AI recharge center allowing users to top up tokens for AI services, with Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu and Kimi already onboard. The unified payment channel could lower barriers for consumers using large-model services and boost AI commercialization.
items.why_zh: 电商平台开始为AI服务提供统一付费入口，有助于加速AI应用走向消费端。
items.why_en: It marks e-commerce platforms entering AI payment infrastructure, potentially accelerating consumer adoption of AI services.

items.title_zh: 充Token如同充话费！天猫上线AI充值中心，阿里云、智谱、Kimi都来了
items.title_en: Recharging tokens like topping up a phone: Tmall launches AI recharge center with Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, and Kimi on board
items.summary_zh: 充Token如同充话费！天猫上线AI充值中心，阿里云、智谱、Kimi都来了 新浪网
items.summary_en: Tmall has launched an AI recharge center that lets users top up tokens for services from Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, and Kimi, much like a mobile phone top-up. The move simplifies access to token-based AI products and signals a shift of AI services into everyday consumer e-commerce channels.
items.why_zh: AI充值中心让Token充值像话费充值一样简单，表明AI服务正深入大众消费场景，降低使用门槛。
items.why_en: It illustrates how AI services are entering mainstream consumer channels, making token-based AI usage more accessible and convenient.

items.title_zh: 英伟达将以129亿美元收购Hugging Face，官方正式宣布
items.title_en: It’s official: Nvidia will acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
items.summary_zh: 据Fortune报道，英伟达（Nvidia）正式宣布将以129亿美元收购AI模型托管平台Hugging Face。Hugging Face是AI开发者广泛使用的模型仓库与社区，在模型发布、微调和应用中扮演重要角色。这笔收购将让英伟达进入AI开发者生态的核心，实现从芯片到模型分发的纵向延伸。如此大规模的并购预计将深刻影响AI产业的合作模式，后续整合进展值得关注。
items.summary_en: It’s official: Nvidia will acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion Fortune
items.why_zh: 这是AI领域规模较大的并购之一，意味着芯片巨头开始直接掌控模型分发入口，影响深远。
items.why_en: As one of AI's biggest acquisitions, it gives a chip giant control over model distribution, reshaping AI's value chain.

items.title_zh: 爱奇艺、网易云音乐、WPS 等多款软件适配小米 18 Fold，官方发文致谢
items.title_en: Xiaomi Thanks Partners as iQIYI, WPS Adapt to Xiaomi 18 Fold
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，小米今日发文致谢爱奇艺、网易云音乐、WPS、剪映、Wind 万得、高德地图等合作伙伴，从工作、日常到休闲娱乐，带来小米 18 Fold 众多恰到好处的大屏适配体验。 据IT之家此前报道，小米 18 Fold 将于 9 月 7 日 19:00 发布， 首发搭载玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰 SoC 。据官方预热，这款新机搭载新形态内屏，采用 √2:1 标准纸张比例，带来更大有效显示面积。 小米 18 Fold 内外一致采用「超级像素技术」、全 RGB 排列， 支持 4000nits 峰值亮度 ，30% APL 日常场景触发，内屏还配备 AR 膜。 新机配备徕卡 2 亿超清主摄（1/1.56″大底传感器）+ 徕卡 5000 万潜望长焦（3.5 倍光学变焦）+ 徕卡 5000 万超广角， 内置 6000mAh 小米金沙江电池 ，支持 67W 有线秒充 + 50W 无线秒充。 外观方面，小米 18 Fold 搭载 5.38 英寸外屏 + 7.58 英寸内屏，新色命名「西野红」，后置镜头模组为横条设计。新机采用极窄四等边 + 超椭圆大 R 角设计，主打“线条优雅”；后置跑道型 Deco + 侧边纯平包裹式中框，主打“利落纯粹”。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi thanked partners including iQIYI, NetEase Cloud Music, WPS, and others for adapting their apps to the Xiaomi 18 Fold's large screen. The foldable is set to launch Sept 7 with the Xuanjie O3 AI flagship SoC, a special inner display, Leica cameras and a 6000mAh battery. Early app adaptation signals a maturing ecosystem for foldables.
items.why_zh: 主流软件在折叠屏新机发布前完成适配，表明折叠屏生态对第三方应用的重要性，也利于新机推广。
items.why_en: Widespread app adaptation before launch reflects the growing importance of foldable-optimized ecosystems and helps drive device adoption.

items.title_zh: 李斌回应蔚来是否会做机器人业务：已投资很多公司，先把车这个事情做好
items.title_en: NIO CEO: Focus on Cars First, Not Building Robots; Has Invested in Robot Startups
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，据新浪科技报道，在蔚来二季度业绩沟通会上，蔚来创始人、董事长、CEO 李斌回应了“蔚来是否会做机器人业务”： 机器人的产业链还在很早期， 我们投了这里面很多的公司 ，其实在我们出现之前，汽车行业也是一个非常大的市场，不能指望什么事情都是蔚来做第一个。 我们先把车卖好 ，把公司变成一个能够有比较好的盈利公司，当然会有很多的选择，汽车公司做机器人不是什么新鲜的事，大部分都在做， 我们先把车这个事情做好 。 据IT之家此前报道，蔚来本月发布的 2026 财年上半年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 6 月）报告显示 ，2026 财年上半年，蔚来营业总收入 576.7 亿元，同比增长 85.9%；毛利润 107.66 亿元，同比增长 282.16%；归母净利润 -12.18 亿元，同比收窄 89.88%。 相关阅读： 《 李斌称市场低估了蔚来：我们不仅是车企，更是 AI 与能源公司 》 《 蔚来李斌：高质量增长不能简单看销量，7 月平均成交价已全面超越 BBA，乐道有战略性新车型 》
items.summary_en: At NIO's Q2 earnings call, CEO Li Bin said NIO has invested in many robotics companies but will not enter the robot business itself for now. He stressed the priority is selling cars and achieving profitability. NIO reported H1 FY2026 revenue of RMB 57.67 billion, up 85.9% YoY, with net loss attributable narrowing 89.88% to RMB 1.218 billion.
items.why_zh: 反映了头部造车新势力在多元业务扩张上的谨慎态度，以及“先盈利”的战略选择。
items.why_en: It highlights NIO's cautious strategy toward diversification and its emphasis on profitability before new ventures.

items.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Astra，宣称AGI时代已经开始
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, claims AGI era has begun
items.summary_zh: OpenAI正式推出GPT-6 Astra，并宣称通用人工智能（AGI）时代已经开始。不过，目前报道中并未披露该模型的具体参数、能力细节或开放方式。这是OpenAI继GPT系列迭代后的又一重大发布，显示出公司对AGI进度的积极表态。该事件可能对AI行业竞争与技术发展方向产生重要影响，后续进展值得密切关注。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, claims AGI era has begun BetaNews
items.why_zh: OpenAI在新品发布时即宣告AGI时代已开始，将重塑外界对AI能力边界的预期。
items.why_en: OpenAI's claim that AGI has begun with GPT-6 Astra resets expectations for AI capabilities and industry progress.

items.title_zh: 工信部：支持国家级人工智能开源社区（AtomGit）发展壮大，鼓励人工智能创业企业积极参与开源生态建设
items.title_en: China's MIIT Rolls Out AI SME Entrepreneurship Support Plan, Backing Open-Source Community AtomGit
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，今日，工业和信息化部办公厅印发《人工智能中小企业创业支持计划（2026-2028 年）》。通过三年，在行业应用、数据服务、智能算力等重点领域，培育形成一大批创新活力强、成长潜力大的 人工智能创业企业 ，新培育科技和创新型中小企业 1 万家以上，专精特新“小巨人”企业突破 2000 家，涌现一批瞪羚企业和独角兽企业。 其中提到，夯实普惠算力资源供给。依托中国算力平台推进算力资源池化整合、弹性配置， 为创业企业提供高效集约的低成本算力支撑 。深入实施普惠算力赋能中小企业发展专项行动，按需建设边缘算力设施，增强算网融合支撑能力，加强普惠智能算力供给。优化中国中小企业服务网算力资源对接专区和中国算力平台中小企业专区功能，推动算力资源与创业企业需求高效匹配。 丰富优质数据资源供给。深入实施工业数据筑基行动，支持行业龙头企业、平台企业、行业协会联合中小企业组建数据合作联合体，围绕智能制造、材料研发、生物医药等领域，率先建设高质量行业数据集， 有序向人工智能创业企业开放 。培育优质数据服务企业，为人工智能创业企业提供数据咨询、治理、标注等服务，降低数据获取成本。支持中小企业数字化转型试点城市在合规前提下加大优质数据资源挖掘，提升中小企业数据工程能力。 培育新型主体壮大创业阵营。鼓励各地对依托智能工具开展敏捷创业的“一人公司”、超级个体等微型主体给予包容支持。加快培育…
items.summary_en: On September 4, China's MIIT issued a plan (2026-2028) to support AI entrepreneurship among SMEs, aiming to foster over 10,000 innovative tech SMEs and more than 2,000 'little giant' firms. The plan expresses support for the national open-source community AtomGit and calls on startups to join open-source initiatives. It also outlines measures to provide low-cost computing resources, open high-quality industry datasets to AI startups, and support micro entities like 'one-person companies' to expand the startup force.
items.why_zh: 该计划是国家层面对AI创业生态的系统性支持，通过算力、数据和开源等基础设施的开放，有望降低创业门槛并激发AI行业创新活力。
items.why_en: This national plan systematically supports AI startups in China by unlocking compute, data, and open-source resources, which could lower barriers to innovation and energize the AI ecosystem.

items.title_zh: OpenAI发布号称“全球最智能”的AI模型GPT-6 Astra
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches 'World's Most Intelligent' AI Model GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_zh: OpenAI今日正式推出新一代旗舰AI模型GPT-6 Astra，并宣称它是“全球最智能”的AI模型。该命名延续了GPT系列，并新增“Astra”后缀，可能与多模态或实时能力有关。目前OpenAI尚未公布具体的参数规模、基准测试分数或可用范围，但这一发布被视为AI竞赛中的又一重要节点。业内人士认为，此举将加剧与Anthropic、Google等对手的竞争，并可能推动企业级AI应用和基础设施投入进一步升级。观察者期待后续技术报告与实测表现来验证“最智能”的说法。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches 'World's Most Intelligent' AI Model GPT-6 Astra NDTV
items.why_zh: GPT-6 Astra的发布可能重新定义大模型能力标杆，并加剧AI行业竞争。
items.why_en: GPT-6 Astra could set a new benchmark in AI capabilities and intensify industry competition.

items.title_zh: 【早报】字节被爆今年AI支出将超2000亿；我国第四代自主超导量子计算机上线
items.title_en: ByteDance's AI Spending This Year Reportedly to Exceed 200 Billion RMB; China Debuts Fourth-Generation Homegrown Superconducting Quantum Computer
items.summary_zh: 【早报】字节被爆今年AI支出将超2000亿；我国第四代自主超导量子计算机上线 财联社
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI spending this year is reported to exceed 200 billion RMB, highlighting its aggressive push into large models and infrastructure. In parallel, China's fourth-generation homegrown superconducting quantum computer has come online, marking continued progress in quantum computing. Specific metrics remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: 一边是互联网巨头巨额押注AI，一边是国产量子计算再上台阶，两者共同牵动科技竞争与产业格局。
items.why_en: Massive AI investment by ByteDance and China's new superconducting quantum computer both signal accelerating tech self-reliance and competition.

items.title_zh: Anthropic即将敲定150亿美元IPO前信贷安排
items.title_en: Watch Anthropic Finalizing $15 Billion Pre-IPO Credit Facility
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，人工智能公司Anthropic正在完成一笔150亿美元的IPO前信贷融资。这种融资通常在公司上市前进行，以较低成本获取资金，帮助其扩展业务和准备上市。此举有望提升Anthropic的财务灵活性，并被视为其可能走向公开市场的最新信号。该笔信贷的规模也显示投资者对头部AI实验室的信心。
items.summary_en: Watch Anthropic Finalizing $15 Billion Pre-IPO Credit Facility Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 这可能是Anthropic冲击IPO前最重要的财务部署，也反映AI头部公司融资规模持续扩大。
items.why_en: This credit facility could be Anthropic's key financial step before IPO, showcasing escalating capital needs in the AI sector.

items.title_zh: 消息称DeepSeek前7个月营收约4.75亿元 算力花了110亿元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Earned 475M Yuan in 7 Months, Spent 11B Yuan on Compute
items.summary_zh: 消息称DeepSeek前7个月营收约4.75亿元 算力花了110亿元 cnBeta.COM
items.summary_en: According to cnBeta, market sources said DeepSeek earned about 475 million yuan in revenue over the first seven months, while spending approximately 11 billion yuan on computing power. If true, the computing costs are more than 20 times revenue, highlighting the enormous capital intensity of LLM startups. The figures have not been officially confirmed.
items.why_zh: 该消息暴露了大模型公司“营收低、算力成本高”的典型困境，可能影响市场对其估值和可持续经营能力的判断。
items.why_en: The reported gap between DeepSeek's revenue and compute spending underscores the severe cost pressures on AI model developers, raising questions about their long-term financial sustainability.

items.title_zh: 李斌称市场低估了蔚来：我们不仅是车企，更是 AI 与能源公司
items.title_en: Li Bin: Market Undervalues NIO; We Are an AI and Energy Company, Not Just an Automaker
items.summary_zh: 9 月 4 日午间消息，在蔚来二季度业绩沟通会上，蔚来创始人、董事长、CEO 李斌回应财报发布后股价波动，他谈到，“资本市场定价就是一个市场价格，里面综合了很多东西，2021 年我们市值很高，但我们公司现在肯定比那个时候更健康， 汽车行业现在还是有点被低估了 。” 李斌认为，今天整个 AI 概念给汽车行业带来了三重暴击：“第一是供应链，AI 产业对算力的渴求，已导致 PCD、铜铁乃至电池等关键物料出现紧缺；第二是人才，具身智能领域热钱涌动，大量公司仅凭几十人团队便坐拥百亿估值，上百家初创企业蜂拥而上，这对技术人才的虹吸效应极为明显；第三是资本，市场注意力被大幅分流。他强调，这并非我们的产品与服务缺乏想象力，而是很多人对我们所在的业务缺乏想象力， 我们本质上是能源公司，也是 AI 公司 ，但同样必须遵循制造业的客观规律，我也很难说服投资人，只能用经营结果去说服。” 李斌认为， 市场对蔚来的价值存在多重低估 。“首先是技术层面，我们的全栈技术自研能力与 AI 实力远未被充分认知；其次是品牌资产的稀缺性；第三是能源业务，其战略价值与盈利潜力同样被低估；此外，服务与社区业务的价值也长期被忽视，去年该业务收入突破 100 亿元，今年一、二季度持续保持增长并实现盈利，全年有望延续稳健增长势头，这是一项基于保有量的确定性收益。” 至于资本市场需要多长时间来重新评估？他谈到，“这不是我们能决定的。…
items.summary_en: At NIO's Q2 earnings call, CEO William Li defended the carmaker's valuation, saying it is now healthier than in 2021 and that the auto industry remains undervalued. He argued that while AI brings supply chain, talent and capital headwinds to car companies, NIO is essentially an AI and energy company. Li also cited underestimated areas including in-house tech, brand assets, energy operations, and a services/community segment that generated over 10 billion yuan in revenue last year.
items.why_zh: 李斌的表态显示蔚来希望以AI和能源公司而非传统车企身份被估值，这将影响资本市场对其长期价值的衡量。
items.why_en: Li's comments signal NIO wants to be valued as an AI/energy company, reshaping how investors assess its long-term worth.

items.title_zh: 字节新一代豆包手机采用长鑫科技LPDDR5X内存 - 快讯
items.title_en: ByteDance's New Doubao Phone Uses CXMT LPDDR5X Memory
items.summary_zh: 字节新一代豆包手机采用长鑫科技LPDDR5X内存 - 快讯 亿邦动力网
items.summary_en: ByteDance's new-generation Doubao phone will use LPDDR5X memory from ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), according to a report from Ebang Power. The move puts CXMT's high-end memory into a major internet firm's device lineup and signals ByteDance's deeper push into AI hardware. Official device specifications and launch timing have not yet been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 该消息显示国产高端内存开始进入头部互联网公司的 AI 手机，既利好长鑫科技，也反映豆包 AI 向终端加速落地。
items.why_en: It marks a win for domestic memory maker CXMT and signals ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao is moving into consumer hardware.

items.summary_en: Renren Yingshi's app has relaunched as “Renren Yingshi Share Wonderful,” operated by Fenxiang Jingcai Network Technology (Jiaxing). CEO Li Yuanmin said targeted promotions will begin this month to reactivate 30 million legacy users, leveraging an AI film-localization model built on 70,000+ episodes. The platform plans to cover more than 50 countries, prioritizing Southeast Asia, with Android already available, iOS ready, and a partnership with Wasu Media in place.
items.why_zh: 人人影视以正版译制身份回归，并用 AI 音色克隆推动国产影视出海，其对存量用户的激活策略值得关注。
items.why_en: The relaunch of Renren Yingshi as a licensed platform using AI voice-cloning technology may invigorate overseas distribution of Chinese content.

The move highlights progress in the domestic memory supply chain for smartphones.

items.title_zh: 英伟达以 130 亿美元与 Hugging Face 达成交易，加码开源 AI
items.title_en: Nvidia Raises Bet on Open-Source AI With $13B Hugging Face Deal
items.summary_zh: 据美国财经媒体《The Daily Upside》报道，英伟达与人工智能开源社区 Hugging Face 达成一项价值 130 亿美元的交易，以进一步加大在开源 AI 生态上的投入。这笔交易的具体形式与条款暂未披露，公开信息仅包含双方名称与金额。Hugging Face 是 AI 社区中重要的模型和数据托管平台，英伟达则是全球 AI 算力芯片的主要供应方。若交易顺利推进，或将对开源模型的开发、部署和算力绑定产生深远影响。相关后续仍需等待更多官方细节。
items.summary_en: Nvidia Raises Bet on Open-Source AI With $13B Hugging Face Deal The Daily Upside
items.why_zh: 开源 AI 平台若与英伟达深度绑定，将影响模型托管生态与算力商业版图，值得业界密切关注。
items.why_en: A tighter Nvidia–Hugging Face link would reshape the economics of AI infrastructure and open-source model distribution.

items.title_zh: 让每次工具调用都有价值：面向智能体视觉语言模型的必要工具证据路径奖励
items.title_en: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注智能体视觉语言模型（VLM）的工具调用训练问题。论文指出，现代VLM能够直接回答许多图像相关的问题，但在需要细粒度视觉细节或外部知识的复杂查询上仍显不足。为此，智能体VLM会调用图像裁剪、图像搜索和文本搜索等工具来获取证据。然而，现有训练范式大多仅依据最终答案的正确性评价工具使用，导致对证据获取与利用过程监督不足，模型经常出现重复或不必要的工具请求。作者提出“必要工具证据路径奖励”方法，旨在确保每次工具调用都对其推理结果产生有效贡献。原文摘要不完整，具体算法设计及实验验证需要查看原文。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can directly answer many image-grounded questions, yet they often struggle with complex queries requiring fine-grained visual details or external knowledge. To acquire this missing evidence, agentic VLMs invoke tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. However, existing training paradigms primarily evaluate tool-use based on final answer correctness, leaving evidence acquisition and utilization insufficiently supervised. This leads to two critical shortcomings: (i) models frequently issue re…
items.why_zh: 该研究为智能体VLM训练中常见的工具滥用问题提供了奖励设计新思路，可提升复杂图像问答的证据利用效率。
items.why_en: It offers a new reward mechanism to align tool use with evidence acquisition in agentic VLMs, improving efficiency for multi-step visual reasoning.

items.title_zh: SHELF：面向多任务书目基准测试的合成测试平台
items.title_en: SHELF: A Synthetic Harness for Multi-Task Bibliographic Benchmarking
items.summary_zh: 图书馆和档案馆需要在人手与计算预算有限的条件下管理大量馆藏，而常见的基准测试并不能系统地评估它们在编目等书目任务上的工作。论文提出了 SHELF（Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness，评估大语言模型适用性的合成平台），这是一个 Python 系统，可将带标签的分类体系、编写规范和生成预算转化为受控的基准数据及评估任务。首个版本包含 62,899 篇模型生成的文档，用于模拟不同类型的馆藏处理工作。该平台有望帮助图书馆和档案馆判断哪些大模型方法适用于自身任务，以及这些方法需要什么样的运行资源。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03047v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Libraries and archives manage large collections with limited staff and computing budgets, yet common benchmarks do not systematically test their bibliographic work. They need to know which methods work for their tasks and what those methods require to run. SHELF, the Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness, addresses this gap. It is a Python system that turns labelled taxonomies, writing specifications, and a generation budget into controlled benchmark data and evaluation tasks. This first release contains 62,899 model-written documents ba…
items.why_zh: 这是少有的针对图书馆编目场景的 LLM 基准工具，能让资源有限的机构在采用 AI 前清楚了解其适用性与成本。
items.why_en: SHELF provides libraries and archives with a practical, controlled way to test LLM performance before deployment, an often-overlooked application domain.

items.title_zh: 低成本开源平台：基于微型阿克曼车辆的端到端自动驾驶研究
items.title_en: A Low-Cost, Open Platform for End-to-End Autonomous Driving on a Miniature Ackermann Vehicle
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍一个面向端到端自动驾驶研究的低成本、开放式实验平台，平台使用小型阿克曼转向车辆。它整合了实体小车、打印的城市轨道、数据采集工具、轨迹配准以及 Webots 数字孪生，支持将基于仿真的自动驾驶方法与真实执行进行受控对接。为验证平台，研究者实现了命令条件行为克隆作为首个基线：神经策略输入车载摄像头图像和高层导航命令，直接输出驾驶控制。该平台或将降低自动驾驶研究的硬件门槛，方便更多团队在真实与仿真环境中复制实验并推进 sim-to-real 迁移。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04147v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents a low-cost, open experimental platform for research in end-to-end autonomous driving with miniature Ackermann vehicles. The platform combines a physical vehicle, a printed urban track, data collection tools, trajectory registration, and a Webots digital twin, enabling controlled experiments that connect simulation-based autonomous-driving methods to real-world execution. As a first baseline, we implement command-conditioned behavior cloning, in which a neural policy receives an on-board camera image and a high-level navigati…
items.why_zh: 该平台使小型低成本车队也能开展端到端驾驶研究，有助于缩小仿真与实际道路之间的鸿沟。
items.why_en: It provides an accessible experimental bridge from simulation to real-world autonomous driving, supporting reproducible studies without full-scale car platforms.

items.title_zh: 预训练期间的知识获取：辅助视角帮助大语言模型学得更好
items.title_en: Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨大语言模型（LLM）在预训练阶段如何获取知识。作者假设，辅助视角，即对知识的重新表述，对知识学习有因果性帮助，并通过受控实验加以验证。实验首先确认，重复是知识习得的必要条件，同时澄清同义改写只在较小的批大小时才对学习有助益。其次，在令牌预算固定的前提下，将原本用于文档重复的令牌改分配给辅助视角，反而能改善学习效果，连事实召回任务也受益于此。这些结果为预训练数据的配比和格式设计提供了新的经验依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04180v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learning. We design controlled experiments to isolate this. First, we confirm that repetition is necessary for acquisition and clarify that paraphrasing helps only at smaller batch sizes. Second, holding the token budget fixed, allocating tokens from document repetition to auxiliary views improves learning, counterintuitively, even for factual recall. Thi…
items.why_zh: 预训练语料中‘重复’与‘改写’的最佳比例一直是实践难题，该研究用对照实验给出了明确线索。
items.why_en: This research clarifies how repetition and auxiliary reformulations shape knowledge learning in LLMs, with practical implications for pre-training dataset design.

items.title_zh: Sionna RT：技术报告
items.title_en: Sionna RT: Technical Report
items.summary_zh: Sionna是一款开源、GPU加速的无线通信仿真库，自0.14版本起集成了用于模拟无线电波传播的射线追踪器Sionna RT。其独特之处在于可微分性，能够计算信道冲激响应、无线电地图等指标对系统参数（如材料属性、天线方向图和阵列几何）的梯度。Sionna 1.0对射线追踪器进行了全面重构，带来显著改进，进一步巩固该工具在基于深度学习的无线信道建模中的地位。这份技术报告介绍了相关实现与特性，对无线通信和电磁仿真研究者具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.21719v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sionna is an open-source, GPU-accelerated library that, as of version 0.14, incorporates a ray tracer, Sionna RT, for simulating radio wave propagation. A unique feature of Sionna RT is differentiability, enabling the calculation of gradients for the channel impulse responses (CIRs), radio maps, and other related metrics with respect to system and environmental parameters, such as material properties, antenna patterns, and array geometries. The release of Sionna 1.0 provided a complete overhaul of the ray tracer, significantly improving…
items.why_zh: Sionna RT的可微分射线追踪为无线信道建模提供了基于梯度的优化能力，是连接无线仿真与机器学习的桥梁。
items.why_en: The differentiable ray tracing in Sionna RT enables gradient-based optimization of radio propagation models, bridging wireless simulation and machine learning.

items.title_zh: 超越可复现性：迈向安全感知的研究工件评估
items.title_en: Beyond Reproducibility: Towards Security-Aware Evaluation of Research Artifacts
items.summary_zh: 研究工件被广泛共享以支撑可复现性，工件评估（AE）已在众多顶级学术会议中成为常态。但现有的AE主要确认工件是否按声明运行且可复现，并未致力于发现或缓解潜在的安全风险。由于这些工件被公开放出并被再次利用，其可能无意间为滥用创造机会，引发对安全与负责任共享的担忧。为探讨这一问题，作者研究了2023至2025年间在顶级会议上发布的1388个研究工件，并对现有评估机制缺少安全维度的情况进行了剖析。该研究呼吁将安全评估引入研究工件的发布与审校流程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.06508v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Research artifacts are widely shared to support reproducibility, and artifact evaluation (AE) has become common at many leading conferences. However, AE mainly checks whether artifacts work as claimed and can be reproduced. It does not aim at spotting or mitigitating potential security risks. Since these artifacts are publicly released and reused, they may unintentionally create opportunities for misuse and raise concerns about safe and responsible sharing. We study 1,388 research artifacts published between 2023 and 2025 at the top-4 s…
items.why_zh: 当前研究工件评估忽视安全风险，可能让恶意利用成为“默认”，该研究为构建安全负责任的学术共享生态提供了方向。
items.why_en: Current artifact evaluation risks overlooking security threats, and this study points toward responsible, security-aware sharing of research outputs.

items.title_zh: 大型开放多能量土壤压实试验语料及机器学习基线
items.title_en: A Large Open Multi-Energy Corpus of Soil Compaction Tests, with Machine-Learning Baselines
items.summary_zh: 工程填方的设计依赖于通过Proctor试验确定的最大干密度与最优含水量。现有相关经验关系往往只基于一至四百个样本，且常来自单一实验室和单一压实能量，数据很少公开。为解决这一局限，论文发布了一个大型开放语料，包含来自六个公开来源的2,854次实验室压实试验，涵盖162个来源组与四种Proctor能量水平，细粒含量范围为1.5%到100%。每条记录都按其来源声明的Proctor方法经过了审计。该语料提供了多源、多能量条件下的系统性数据，并配有机器学习基线，为土工材料的数据驱动建模与标准化方法研究奠定了基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every engineered fill is specified by a maximum dry density and an optimum moisture content. Each determination needs a full Proctor test. Published correlations rest on one to four hundred specimens, usually from one laboratory at one compactive energy, and are seldom released. This paper releases a corpus without those limits. It holds 2,854 laboratory compaction tests from six public sources, across 162 provenance groups and four Proctor energy levels, with fines from 1.5 to 100%. Every record is audited to the Proctor method its source names,…
items.why_zh: 首个大规模多来源多能量土壤压实开放数据集，可支撑更可靠的经验模型与机器学习研究。
items.why_en: A first large-scale multi-energy soil compaction corpus enabling more reliable correlations and data-driven models.

items.title_zh: 从零到英雄：面向亚美尼亚语的开源大模型生态系统
items.title_en: From Zero to Hero: An Open LLM Ecosystem for Armenian
items.summary_zh: 亚美尼亚语是一种形态丰富但资源匮乏的语言，其预训练语料稀缺，且目前尚无可复现的开源亚美尼亚语大语言模型及其训练数据与配方。为填补这一空白，研究者创建并发布了两个数据集：ArmWeb是一个经过充分验证的语料库，包含437万篇亚美尼亚语新闻文档；ArmSTEM包含37.3万道英-亚平行的数学与科学题目及逐步解答，并通过保留答案的大模型自动评判和人工评估完成验证。借助这些数据可以进行持续预训练，进而发展出开放可复现的亚美尼亚语大语言模型。该工作为资源匮乏语言的AI生态提供了可参考的构建路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretraining data for Armenian, a morphologically rich and low-resource language, is scarce, and no open Armenian LLM has been released with the data and recipe needed to reproduce it. To address this gap, we curate and release two datasets. ArmWeb is an extensively validated corpus of 4.37M Armenian news documents. ArmSTEM is a parallel English-Armenian collection of 373K math and science problems with step-by-step solutions, translated into Armenian and verified through both answer-preserving LLM judgment and human evaluation. Continued pretrain…
items.why_zh: 为资源匮乏的亚美尼亚语提供了开源数据与可复现训练的基础，推动大语言模型的语种多样性。
items.why_en: It lays the data and reproducibility groundwork for open Armenian LLMs, promoting language diversity in AI.

items.title_zh: 注意差距：PII检测系统的鲁棒性风险
items.title_en: Mind the Gap: Robustness Risks in PII Detection Systems
items.summary_zh: 个人身份信息（PII）检测是数据保护基础设施中的关键一环，漏检将直接带来隐私和安全风险。尽管现代PII检测系统在标准基准上表现良好，但该研究表明，这些评估掩盖了部署时在真实分布偏移下的重大鲁棒性缺陷。研究并未比较各方法的最先进准确率，而是系统考察不同PII检测范式在含噪、非结构化和非正式输入条件下的失败模式。结果显示，PII检测在面对实际数据变异时的性能远低于基准测试所暗示的水平，提示相关安全评估亟需引入更贴近真实场景的测试。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection is a foundational component of data protection infrastructure where missed entities constitute direct privacy and security risks. Although modern PII systems report strong performance on standard benchmarks, we show that these evaluations mask substantial robustness failures under realistic distribution shifts encountered in deployment. Rather than comparing state-of-the-art accuracy, we study how different PII detection paradigms fail under noisy, unstructured, and informal inputs. We construct…
items.why_zh: 只关注标准准确率会造成PII系统安全性被高估，该研究提醒隐私保护需要接受真实场景的鲁棒性考验。
items.why_en: It reveals that benchmark accuracy overstates the safety of PII detection, urging robustness testing under real-world conditions.

items.title_zh: 基于回归引导累积量的联邦因果发现
items.title_en: Federated Causal Discovery via Regression-Directed Cumulants
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究在联邦学习环境中应用线性非高斯无环模型（LiNGAM）进行因果发现。这类模型可以突破马尔可夫等价类的局限，提供更强的因果识别能力。实际中不少领域数据稀缺，而由于GDPR等法规限制，将客户数据集中处理并不可行；联邦环境为兼顾隐私与因果结构学习精度提供了方案。标准集中式估计器DirectLiNGAM无法直接用于联邦框架，因此作者提出一种利用回归引导累积量的新方法，以在数据不出本地的情况下完成因果方向推断。这一路线有助于在隐私约束下利用分布式数据得到可解释的因果模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we study linear non-Gaussian acyclic models (LiNGAM) when used in federated environments. These causal models allow one to go beyond Markov equivalence. However, in many domains data are scarce, and increasing the sample size by centralising data from different clients is not advisable due to regulations such as the GDPR. The federated environment offers an attractive option to balance privacy and causal discovery accuracy. Unfortunately, the standard centralised estimator in the LiNGAM setting, i.e., DirectLiNGAM, cannot be straigh…
items.why_zh: 在GDPR等法规下，联邦因果发现既能利用多方数据，又避免隐私泄露，为因果推断提供了新途径。
items.why_en: It enables privacy-preserving causal discovery across distributed data, aligning with regulations such as GDPR.

items.title_zh: RobustSeiz：脑电癫痫检测模型鲁棒性开源评测框架
items.title_en: RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models
items.summary_zh: 尽管癫痫发作检测模型在留出脑电（EEG）数据上表现出色，但在真实世界的采集变化、伪影和对抗性干扰下仍可能失效。为此，研究者推出了RobustSeiz——一个开源、模型无关的评测框架，为在部署前通过受控且临床相关的分布偏移对发作检测器进行标准化、可复现的压力测试与比较而设计。该框架将CHB-MIT、TUSZ、Siena和SeizeIT1四个公开头皮EEG数据集整理为BIDS-EEG目录形式，并采用受试者独立评估来衡量模型的泛化能力。RobustSeiz有望提供统一的鲁棒性基准，帮助临床和工程社区更可信地评估并改进癫痫检测系统。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-inde…
items.why_zh: 为癫痫检测模型在临床部署前提供了标准化的鲁棒性测试协议，减少实际应用中的安全隐忧。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized robustness benchmark for EEG seizure detectors, addressing reliability gaps before clinical deployment.

items.title_zh: 动态图异常检测中的统计特征增强
items.title_en: Statistical Feature Augmentation for Anomaly Detection in Dynamic Graphs
items.summary_zh: 动态网络广泛存在于社交媒体、物流系统等领域，不同场景的数据具有不同的特性。用于这类数据的模型需要捕捉时间或拓扑结构与基于特征的信息之间的关联。然而，最先进的深度学习模型往往难以直接从原始事件流中学习短期行为交互信号，例如发送者强度或交互惯性。为弥补这一不足，研究者提出了一种统计特征增强方法，以帮助模型更好地捕捉此类短期行为模式，从而提升动态图异常检测的效果。该工作为动态图上的深度学习模型提供了实用且有效的增强手段。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.02965v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamic networks are being applied in many domains, from social media to logistics systems, each with their own set of special characteristics. A model employed on this type of data must capture the duality between temporal/structural and feature-based information. Yet state-of-the-art deep learning models often struggle to learn especially short-term behavioral interaction signals, such as sender intensity or interaction inertia, directly from raw event streams. To address this gap, we propose a statistical feature augmentation method that exp…
items.why_zh: 为动态图异常检测提供了一种能捕捉短时交互信号的增强思路，弥补了深度模型在行为特征学习上的短板。
items.why_en: It offers a way to complement deep models with statistical features, improving detection of short-term anomalous interactions in dynamic networks.

items.title_zh: 带差分隐私和拜占庭鲁棒聚合的联邦学习：面向银行与医疗系统的安全跨域训练框架
items.title_en: Differentially private federated learning with Byzantine-robust aggregation: A cross-domain framework for secure model training in banking and healthcare systems
items.summary_zh: 这篇来自arXiv的论文提出一个跨域框架，将差分隐私与拜占庭鲁棒聚合结合，用于银行、医院等受监管机构的安全联邦学习。联邦学习允许这些机构在不共享原始数据的情况下协同训练模型，但客户端交换的参数更新仍可能通过梯度反演和成员推理攻击泄露本地隐私；同时，FedAvg这类简单平均规则无法防御恶意客户端发起的拜占庭攻击。该框架的目标是同时缓解这两类风险，提升联邦学习在数据高度敏感行业的可信度与实用性。该框架设计可为相关产业场景提供安全训练的潜在解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03064v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated learning allows banks, hospitals, and other regulated organizations to train a shared model without moving raw records off their own servers, which is attractive wherever data protection law or competitive sensitivity rules out pooling data centrally. Two problems limit how far this promise can be trusted in practice. First, the parameter updates that clients exchange still leak information about local records through gradient inversion and membership inference attacks. Second, an honest averaging rule such as FedAvg has no defense ag…
items.why_zh: 它为银行、医疗等强监管行业提供了一条在保护数据隐私的同时对抗恶意节点的联邦学习可行路径。
items.why_en: It provides a viable path for privacy-preserving and Byzantine-robust federated learning in highly regulated sectors.

items.title_zh: 面向符号回归的高效常数优化：基于GPU加速的树形遗传编程方法
items.title_en: Efficient Constant Optimization for Symbolic Regression with GPU-Accelerated Tree-Based Genetic Programming
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注树形遗传编程用于符号回归时的常数优化问题，指出GPU加速框架常因逐代优化成本过高而省略或仅使用轻量级常数优化。作者提出一种驻留于GPU的批处理Levenberg-Marquardt求解器，能在每次迭代中仅通过固定次数的全局CUDA启动，对结构异构的表达式种群进行常数批量优化。反向模式自动微分被用于组装每棵表达式树的雅可比矩阵。该方法将常数优化融入现代GPU遗传编程流程，有望在不大幅增加计算开销的情况下提升符号回归模型的精度，为可扩展的符号回归工具提供了重要技术支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03352v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Constant optimization refines the numerical coefficients of candidate expressions in tree-based genetic programming for symbolic regression. But its per-generation cost has led modern GPU-accelerated frameworks to omit it or restrict it to lightweight forms. We present a GPU-resident, batched Levenberg--Marquardt solver that optimizes constants across a structurally heterogeneous population of expression trees using a fixed number of population-wide CUDA launches per iteration. Reverse-mode automatic differentiation assembles the per-tree Jacob…
items.why_zh: 该研究弥补了当前GPU加速符号回归框架在常数优化方面的空白，有望显著提升模型拟合质量与进化效率。
items.why_en: It fills the missing piece of constant optimization in GPU-based symbolic regression, potentially boosting model accuracy and evolutionary efficiency.

items.title_zh: 摩尔线程“庐山”GPU 首发国产硬件光追：3A 游戏渲染提升 15 倍，预计年底推出
items.title_en: Moore Threads 'Lushan' GPU Features Domestic Hardware Ray Tracing: 15x 3A Rendering, Launch Expected by Late 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，在 9 月 3 日下午的摩尔线程 2026 年半年度业绩说明会上，摩尔线程官方表示，在 2025 年 12 月首届 MUSA 开发者大会中，公司发布了新一代“花港”架构以及基于该架构的高性能图形渲染“庐山”芯片，未来将为游戏与图形用户提供全新升级体验， 该芯片预计将实现 3A 游戏渲染提升 15 倍，AI 性能提升 64 倍，光线追踪性能提升 50 倍 。 摩尔线程官方在业绩说明会透露， “庐山”芯片预计 2026 年底推出 ，具体的产品上线销售时间请以后续官方发布为准。 IT之家注意到，在 2025 年 12 月首届 MUSA 开发者大会中， 摩尔线程发布了两项核心渲染技术 ，率先拥抱“图形 +AI”范式革命： 迈入实时光追时代： 基于“花港”架构的硬件光线追踪加速引擎 ，可实现对 DirectX Raytracing (DXR) 的支持，使实时、逼真的光影效果在国产 GPU 上成为可能。 定义 AI 生成式渲染（AGR）：推出全自研 MTAGR 1.0 技术，推动渲染技术范式从“计算”走向“生成”，为下一代数字内容创作及数字孪生等场景构建国产技术基座。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 semi-annual conference, Moore Threads said its 'Lushan' GPU, based on the Huagang architecture, is expected to launch by late 2026. The company claims 15x 3A rendering, 64x AI, and 50x ray-tracing performance gains. Lushan supports hardware ray tracing with DirectX Raytracing; Moore Threads also unveiled its self-developed MTAGR 1.0 AI-generated rendering technology.
items.why_zh: 国产GPU在硬件光追和AI生成式渲染上取得关键进展，有望重塑国内图形与智能视觉生态。
items.why_en: This marks a key step for domestic GPUs in hardware ray tracing and AI-driven rendering, potentially reshaping China's graphics ecosystem.

items.why_en: It underscores the push of AI agents into real-world task execution, though the actual utility remains to be seen.

items.why_zh: 它折射出高收入AI公司依然高度依赖外部融资的行业现象，促使市场重新评估AI企业的资金需求模式。
items.why_en: It reflects the ongoing reliance of high-revenue AI firms on external capital, prompting a rethink of AI startup financing dynamics.

items.title_zh: 飞腾 D3000M + 160TOPS NPU：国科亿道携手后摩智能发布 FN008 笔电
items.title_en: Phytium D3000M + 160TOPS NPU: Guoke Yidao and Houmo AI Launch FN008 Laptop
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，后摩智能 ( HOUMO.AI ) 昨日宣布了其与国科亿道合作开发的 FN008 AI 笔记本电脑。 这一全栈国产化型号基于飞腾 D3000M 处理器， 搭载后摩智能的后摩漫界 M50 dNPU ，运行基于 Linux 操作系统的 KylinOS 发行版，配备国密级 TPM 芯片。 后摩漫界 M50 拥有 160 TOPS INT8 算力、100 TFLOPS bFP16 算力 ，典型功耗 10W，配备 24GB 内存。其可本地运行 35B 模型，支持 DeepSeek、ChatGLM、Qwen、LLaMA、Stable Diffusion、WizardCoder、CodeFuse，提供 AI 智能问答、AI 会议助手、AI 智护办公。
items.summary_en: Houmo AI and Guoke Yidao have launched the FN008 AI laptop, powered by Phytium D3000M and the Houmo Manjie M50 dNPU with 160 TOPS INT8 performance. It runs KylinOS, features a TPM chip, 24GB RAM, and can run 35B-class models locally, including DeepSeek, ChatGLM, Qwen, LLaMA, and Stable Diffusion.
items.why_zh: 这是国产CPU与国产NPU在AI笔记本上的一次深度整合，为本地大模型应用提供了全栈自主方案。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a fully domestic CPU+NPU platform for AI laptops, offering an indigenous path to local LLM deployment.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek投资份额有多抢手？1亿元入场先收1800万前端费用

items.summary_en: Phoenix Technology reports that DeepSeek investment shares are extremely sought-after, with intermediaries charging an 18 million yuan upfront fee on a 100 million yuan investment. items.why_en: The steep upfront fee highlights a strong seller's market for DeepSeek equity, urging investors to weigh intermediary costs carefully.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 投资份额有多抢手？1 亿元入场先收 1800 万前端费用，五年锁定期无投票权
items.title_en: DeepSeek Shares in High Demand: 18M Upfront Fee for 100M Entry, 5-Year Lock-up, No Voting Rights
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，据《财经》杂志昨日报道，围绕 DeepSeek 投资份额，有部分中间通道开出了“前端 18%、后端 35%”的收费条件。 按照这一标准，投资人出资 1 亿元，需先支付 1800 万元前端费用，未来获得投资收益后还要拿出 35% 作为收益分成。作为对比，一般情况下基金管理人每年收取的管理费约为基金规模的 2%。 即使接受高额费用，投资人也无法保证最终获得 DeepSeek 份额。报道称，DeepSeek 会审核参与融资的投资人身份，部分自然人单笔出资门槛达到 1 亿元。此外，DeepSeek 要求对所有出资基金背后的有限合伙人（LP）进行穿透式身份核查，以避免份额落入不明主体手中。相关投资面临五年锁定期，期间不得转让。除国家人工智能产业投资基金外，多数外部投资者不享有投票权，不设董事会席位，仅能按出资比例分享财务收益。 围绕 DeepSeek 融资，市场上还出现了大量虚假份额和中间人乱象。一家名为嘉兴时远的机构曾声称获得约 100 亿元的投资份额。其相关负责人何伟随后向《财经》表示，自己从未与 DeepSeek 接触，也不是市场传言中的幻方量化首席财务官。首轮融资完成后，嘉兴时远及另一家高调募资的机构“青岛浩正”均未出现在最终投资名单中。 为获取份额，甚至有投资人曾支付 500 万元“见面费”，希望与梁文锋见面。该投资人提前两天赶到杭州，在 DeepSe…
items.summary_en: Caijing reports that intermediaries demand an 18% upfront fee and 35% carry for DeepSeek investment allocations. An investor committing 100 million yuan must pay 18 million upfront and still may fail to secure shares, as DeepSeek imposes strict identity and LP checks. Investments require a 5-year lock-up; most external investors get no voting rights or board seats. The market also saw fake allocations and brokers, with one investor paying 5 million yuan just to meet founder Liang Wenfeng.
items.why_zh: 该报道揭示了DeepSeek融资背后极为苛刻的准入条件、高门槛与中间层乱象，是观察顶级AI资产投融资生态的重要样本。
items.why_en: The report reveals the extreme conditions and broker chaos surrounding DeepSeek fundraising, serving as a vivid sample of top-tier AI asset investment dynamics.

items.title_zh: 天猫上线Token充值中心，首批接入阿里云、智谱、Kimi、MiniMax_快讯
items.title_en: Tmall Launches Token Purchase Center, Initially Integrating Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi and MiniMax
items.summary_zh: 天猫上线Token充值中心，首批接入阿里云、智谱、Kimi、MiniMax_快讯 iheima.com
items.summary_en: Tmall has launched a token purchase center, initially supporting AI services from Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi and MiniMax. Users can buy large-model tokens directly on the platform, simplifying purchases for developers and enterprises. The move highlights the growing integration of e-commerce and AI service delivery.

items.summary_en: Lenovo introduced the IdeaPad Vibe laptops and IdeaCentre AIO i all-in-one PCs at IFA 2026. The Vibe offers seven color options in 14- and 15-inch sizes, with Snapdragon X or AMD Ryzen CPUs and prices starting at €799. The AIO i comes in six colors and 24/27-inch models, based on an Intel 'Wildcat Lake' processor and featuring a 120Hz FHD display.
items.why_zh: 联想以多彩设计和灵活配置满足差异化需求，彰显其对个人化消费电子的市场布局。
items.why_en: The new colorful devices highlight Lenovo's strategy to target personalization and diverse consumer needs in the PC market.

items.why_en: The wide gap between revenue and compute spending raises crucial questions about AI startups' profitability and sustainability.

items.title_zh: 消息称 Meta 调整 AI 绩效考核标准，取消 Token 使用量指标
items.title_en: Meta Adjusts AI Performance Review Criteria, Drops Token Usage Metric
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，据外媒 The Information 昨日报道，Meta 告知工程师， 绩效评估将不再包含 AI Token 的使用量 。 Meta 内部一份最新备忘录显示，Meta 高管 Maher Saba 与 Santosh Janardhan 于当地时间周二联合发布了面向全公司工程师的最新绩效期望指引。备忘录明确表示， Meta“不会使用 AI 采用率仪表盘或 Token 使用量来评估员工影响力” 。 新版绩效期望指引删除了此前对具体 AI 工具的引用，也删除了针对特定任务的 AI 使用指令，转而以工作质量与实际影响作为核心考量维度。 备忘录还披露，目前 Meta 内部 93% 的代码变更已由 AI 智能体辅助完成，并表示目标不是 AI 采用率本身，而是更高质量的交付与更快速的迭代。 IT之家注意到，该媒体今年 6 月还报道称， Meta 已向 6,000 名员工发送内部备忘录 ，通过名为 AI GateWay 的平台统一管理 AI 使用情况，各团队能够查看自身的 AI 用量数据， 当 Token 支出出现异常增长时，系统会自动发出警报通知 。 Meta 在备忘录中指出，公司内部的 AI 使用量正快速增长， 员工们今年内使用的 AI 工具可能需要花费数百亿美元 。 图源：Pexels
items.summary_en: Meta has told engineers it will stop using AI token usage as a performance metric. An internal memo says the company will assess impact based on quality and actual results instead of adoption dashboards or token counts. Notably, about 93% of code changes at Meta are now AI-assisted, but the revised guidance prioritizes high-quality delivery and fast iteration over AI usage volume.
items.why_zh: 反映企业不再鼓励“为指标而用AI”，更看重AI带来的实际业务价值。
items.why_en: It signals a move away from vanity AI metrics toward impact-based evaluation, avoiding misuse of AI just for token counts.

items.why_en: Releasing a new flagship GPT is a landmark event that will drive upgrades in AI capabilities and applications.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Cybercab 在美正式投运：无方向盘与踏板，9 月中旬起在北京上海等多城展出
items.title_en: Tesla's Cybercab Officially Launches in the US: No Steering Wheel or Pedals, to Be Exhibited in Beijing, Shanghai and More Cities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，当地时间 9 月 3 日，特斯拉在美国得州奥斯汀举行发布会，宣布旗下赛博无人驾驶网约车 Cybercab 正式投入运营。据官方消息，Cybercab 自美国中部时间周五下午 5 点起对公众开放试乘。 作为全球首款专为无人驾驶场景打造的量产车型，Cybercab 在设计上取消了方向盘、踏板与传统后视镜，车辆行驶完全由特斯拉无人驾驶软件驱动，座舱内仅保留两张长椅式座椅与一块中控触摸屏。 该车型最初于 2024 年 10 月在特斯拉“We, Robot”活动中首次以概念车身份亮相，2026 年 2 月首台量产车在得州超级工厂下线，4 月启动正式量产，从概念发布到量产落地历时约 18 个月。其采用的拆箱式制造工艺通过子组件并行生产、再进行总装的方式，提升了生产效率并优化了制造成本。 Cybercab 采用特斯拉纯视觉端到端方案，依托 8 颗高清摄像头组成的感知阵列实现环境感知，不依赖激光雷达与高精地图（端到端方案指将传感器采集的原始数据直接输入神经网络，由模型一次性输出驾驶决策，无需分模块处理）。 据特斯拉数据，截至 2026 年 9 月，全球特斯拉车队累计辅助驾驶里程已超过 225 亿公里，每日新增行车数据相当于一人连续驾驶 500 年所产生的数据总量，为无人驾驶技术迭代提供支撑。 能效方面，据特斯拉官方数据，Cybercab 预估能效达每度电行驶 9.8…
items.summary_en: Tesla officially launched its Cybercab robotaxi in Austin, Texas, on September 3, with public rides starting Friday at 5 p.m. CT. The vehicle has no steering wheel, pedals or mirrors, relying on a vision-based end-to-end system using eight cameras. It is also scheduled for public exhibitions in Beijing, Shanghai and other cities starting mid-September.
items.why_zh: Cybercab正式运营是特斯拉自动驾驶商业化的关键节点，也掀开无人出行新篇章。
items.why_en: It marks a critical milestone in Tesla's autonomous-driving business, paving the way for commercial robotaxi services.

items.title_zh: 微软最强转录 AI 模型：MAI-Transcribe-2 登场，60 语种平均词错误率 5.2%
items.title_en: Microsoft launches its strongest transcription AI model MAI-Transcribe-2, with 5.2% average word error rate across 60 languages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，微软昨日（9 月 3 日）发布博文，宣布推出 MAI-Transcribe-2， 宣称是其最快、最准确、最便宜的 AI 语音转文字模型。 在定价方面，MAI-Transcribe-2 上市时限时收费 0.10 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 0.67 元人民币） / 小时，优惠持续至 2026 年年底。 性能方面，MAI-Transcribe-2 是微软最强的转录模型，相比较市场上其它主流模型，在准确率、速度和价格方面存在优势。 在 FLEURS 测试集中，MAI-Transcribe-2 支持强制指定语言和自动推断语言两种模式，平均词错误率均为 5.2%。同一测试中，Gemini 3.1 Pro 的两项结果分别为 5.3% 和 5.8%；GPT-Transcribe 为 10.4% 和 10.6%；Whisper v3-Large 为 22.8% 和 23.5%。 速度方面，微软援引 Artificial Analysis 评测称，MAI-Transcribe-2 比 GPT-Transcribe 快 10 倍，比 Scribe v2 快 7 倍，比 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 快 5 倍。 功能方面，MAI-Transcribe-2 新增说话人分离功能，可在一段录音内区分不同发言者，并将文字归属到对应说话人。逐词时间戳可为每个词标注…
items.summary_en: Microsoft announced MAI-Transcribe-2, claiming it is its fastest, most accurate, and most affordable speech-to-text model. It is priced at $0.10 per hour until the end of 2026. In FLEURS tests, it achieved an average word error rate of 5.2% in both forced and automatic language modes, outperforming Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-Transcribe, and Whisper v3-Large. Microsoft says it is 10x faster than GPT-Transcribe, 7x faster than Scribe v2, and 5x faster than Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. New features include speaker separation and word-level timestamps.
items.why_zh: 微软以更低价格和更高准确率切入语音转录市场，可能对现有 AI 转录服务格局形成冲击。
items.why_en: Microsoft's low-cost, high-accuracy model could disrupt the AI transcription market.

items.title_zh: 英伟达开源发布 PAIR：本地跑 AI 新方案，调度 Mac / RTX PC 跨设备推理
items.title_en: NVIDIA open-sources PAIR: a new on-device AI solution that routes requests across Mac and RTX PCs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（9 月 3 日）发布博文，报道称英伟达以开源测试版状态，推出 Personal AI Router（PAIR）软件， 用于在局域网内为本地 AI 请求选择可用计算机，类似把任务分派给空闲工位的调度员。 在兼容设备上，该软件可以在 M4 以及更高的 Mac 设备、英伟达 RTX PC 和 DGX Spark 设备上运行，为 Ollama、LM Studio 等本地 AI 工具提供统一请求入口。用户可在家庭或办公局域网内，将多个独立 AI 请求调度至空闲设备处理。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 产品定位方面，英伟达将 PAIR 定位为局域网内的本地 AI 请求调度软件，能自动发现已加入的电脑，并将每项请求分配给可用设备。模型仍由目标设备上的 Ollama 或 LM Studio 运行，因此用户不必为每款 AI 应用分别配置每一台机器。 在某台设备繁忙或不可用后，PAIR 可把新请求转向其他已配对设备。例如，AI 智能体同时审阅多份文档时，可将彼此独立的任务分别交给不同计算机处理。该机制面向并发负载分担，并不意味着单个 AI 回复会因加入更多电脑而自动变快。 英伟达演示显示，在 Hermes 中使用 Ollama 与 Qwen 3.6 35B A3B 模型，将任务拆分给 5 个 AI 子智能体后，RTX Spark 笔记…
items.summary_en: NVIDIA has released Personal AI Router (PAIR) as an open-source beta, a local network scheduler that routes AI requests to available computers such as M4 Macs, RTX PCs, and DGX Spark. It works with Ollama and LM Studio, distributing independent requests across idle devices for concurrent workloads. A demo showed task splitting among five AI subagents.
items.why_zh: PAIR 解决了本地 AI 多设备协同调度问题，让家庭或办公场景中的 AI 硬件得到更充分利用。
items.why_en: PAIR enables efficient use of distributed local AI hardware by intelligently routing requests across devices.

items.title_en: OpenAI commits $1 billion to AI cybersecurity, prioritizing critical services like water and power
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 4 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布推出“Daybreak for Frontline Defenders”计划，承诺投入 10 亿美元 （现汇率约合 67.36 亿元人民币） ，为资源有限的网络安全防御团队提供 Daybreak 访问权限、培训、技术支持及合作服务，帮助其利用前沿 AI 保护供水、电力、地方政府和金融等关键服务。 IT之家注：Daybreak Access 是 OpenAI 的网络安全可信访问计划。Daybreak Blue 和 Daybreak Red 是两个访问级别。 OpenAI 表示，这项全球计划首先在美国展开，并计划在未来数周扩展至合作国家。10 亿美元资金预计将在未来 6 个月内用于相关 Daybreak 服务，重点面向缺乏大型企业级安全资源的机构。 “Daybreak for America”将整合 OpenAI 在美国保护关键系统方面的相关工作，服务对象包括供水及污水处理系统、电网运营商、州和地方政府、社区及地区银行、非营利组织、开源项目维护者等。 OpenAI 称，这些机构往往需要在人员、预算和专业安全能力有限的情况下维护复杂且老旧的系统。Daybreak 可用于审查遗留代码、分析可疑活动、发现并验证漏洞、确定高风险问题优先级，以及开发和测试修复方案。 此次计划也延续了 OpenAI 此前针对美国供水系统的支持。在美国供水系统遭遇…
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced the 'Daybreak for Frontline Defenders' initiative, committing $1 billion to help under-resourced cybersecurity teams protect critical services such as water, power, government, and finance. Starting in the US and expanding to partner countries in coming weeks, the program provides access to Daybreak, training, and technical support to be delivered over the next six months.
items.why_zh: 巨额投入表明 OpenAI 正积极推动 AI 在关键基础设施防护中的落地，可能重塑网络安全攻防格局。
items.why_en: The $1 billion commitment highlights OpenAI's push to apply AI to critical infrastructure defense, potentially reshaping cybersecurity.
